subject: txn: skips resolving lock in auto commit optimistic statement (#58676)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent only. Change introduces kv option `PrewriteEncounterLockPolicy` and wires it through TiDB->client-go so retryable autocommit optimistic txns can skip lock resolving during prewrite (client-go returns write-conflict immediately), encouraging upper-layer retry in pessimistic mode; also marks pipelined optimistic txns as non-retryable and refactors txn begin options plumbing. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/consistency/session/kv/store issues found in the touched scope, and `git log -S` over `upstream/master` shows no later follow-up edits to this option/logic that would indicate a subsequent fix.
